title: Discharge time expression
description: Essential: The response must state the discharge time as t = (π/2)√(LC) or an equivalent form.

title: Average current expression
description: Essential: The response must state the average current as I_avg = (2E/π)√(C/L) or an equivalent form.

title: LC oscillation period recognition
description: Important: The solution should identify the discharge as a quarter-period of an LC oscillation, using T = 2π√(LC).

title: Average current definition
description: Important: The solution must apply the definition I_avg = Δq/Δt, where Δq is the total charge that flows (CE).

title: Charge flow identification
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly identify the initial charge on the capacitor as CE and that it fully discharges to zero.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions should have correct units for time (s) and current (A), or a dimensional check should be implied.

title: Confusing period with discharge time
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly states the discharge time as the full period T = 2π√(LC).

title: Incorrect average current formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses I_avg = (I_max)/2 or another incorrect average, rather than Δq/Δt.
